summary: Washburn County, WI tower listed as standing with no register number. Its only documented source is a National Geodetic Survey data sheet; no build or staffing history found.

evidence.supports: the source is a National Geodetic Survey data sheet, a survey record
listed as standing, with no register number

corrections.why: A National Geodetic Survey data sheet is a survey record that names a station, not the body that built or runs the tower

notes_for_editor: Location conflict unresolved: record shows FFLA 45.98554, -91.80243 against central_us_lookouts 45.98306, -91.81611 (about 1,092 m apart). The Forest Lookouts page we read does not show coordinates, so we could not check the second point. No build, design, height, staffing or fate found. A search snippet linking Lampson to Brooklyn Township and a 1903 schoolhouse is about the community, not the tower, and is not used. Access unknown.
